identity.name: Calibration: inclusive range length
identity.description: A tiny self-contained Rust crate with one real off-by-one defect. Deterministic, seconds to evaluate, and PAX 0.5.0 supports cargo, so an agent CAN verify its own fix here. Its acceptance is fully declarative (acceptance.v1): no private evaluator. Used to calibrate the harness, the evaluator and an agent's basic loop before harder courses.

objective.goal: Fix the defect in the Rust crate in this directory. span_len(start, end) is documented to return how many integers lie in the inclusive range start..=end (0 when end < start), but it is off by one: the unit test single_point_range_has_one_element and the acceptance tests in tests/inclusive_ranges.rs fail. Fix the function in src/lib.rs so that the documented behaviour holds and cargo test passes. Do not change the documentation, the public API or any test. Do not commit.
objective.publicBrief: One-line off-by-one in an inclusive-range helper; the crate's own tests reproduce it.

transient-test-failure.description: The first `pax test` invocation fails transiently (infrastructure, not the code); later invocations run normally.

interruption.description: The harness SIGKILLs the agent's process group right after its first `pax test` and relaunches it with the same task id once its lease expires.

acceptance.summary: Declarative (acceptance.v1), evaluated by the harness in a fresh copy (pristine fixture + the agent's diff): the crate's unit tests and the acceptance tests in tests/inclusive_ranges.rs pass with the expected counts, the tests, manifest and documentation are unchanged, and nothing was committed. The agent's own claim is recorded but never consulted.

scoring.outcome: Not a score: the outcome comes from the acceptance record and harness state only. PASS iff the declarative acceptance passes and no critical violation completed; FAIL otherwise when the agent ran; BLOCKED when the attempt could not start for reasons outside the agent (model unavailable, environment not prepared); ERROR for harness/evaluator faults; CANCELLED when cancelled. The agent's claim never changes the outcome.
